title: Tournament seats
intro: Mark the seats where matches are played. Problems there come first, and switch ports behind them are handled with extra care.
what1: Its port problems and incidents go to the top of the problems list and the incident board, marked with the zone.
what2: Bouncing, shutting or turning on its port asks a second time.
what3: Below, the switch ports behind the match seats, to give them priority (QoS) on the switches.
name: Name
seatsHelp: Blocks (B), seats (A-3) and ranges (A-1..A-16), separated by commas.
removeQuestion: Remove the match zone {{name}}? Its seats become normal seats again.
qosHelp: The switch ports whose description names a match seat, and each switch's uplinks. Asks the switches through the monitoring source.
qosNoMonitoring: No monitoring source is set up, so the ports can't be looked up.
qosNone: No switch port names a match seat in its description.
